resolutions: Nominal incorporation is one canonical operation combining typed NNC and VNC Sources rather than a list of example-specific routes.
The noun contributes its general-use stem and the application preserves the internal NNC-VNC boundary.
Object, adverb, and complement are distinct grammatical relations rather than translation labels.
Only incorporated-object formation reduces matrix valence under the accepted Groups 1-3 scope.
An incorporated object fills exactly one typed matrix object position.
A single-object matrix therefore becomes intransitive and carries no nuclear object pronoun.
The finite subject is preserved when the sole object position is consumed.
A double-object matrix retains one object after incorporation.
A triple-object matrix retains two objects after incorporation.
Remaining objects keep their governor and derivational level instead of being rebuilt from surface spelling.
The structurally oldest compatible object is consumed automatically when the typed Source supplies one match.
A role control is required only when the typed Source explicitly supplies more than one compatible object match.
A requested role that is not among the typed compatible matches is rejected.
An intransitive matrix cannot authorize incorporated-object formation.
The passive of a single-object incorporated Result is rejected because no object remains to support it.
Compatible invented nounstem and verbstem shapes pass the same productive rule; Canvas witnesses never gate admission.
The complete canonical VNC Result remains available through the ordinary Later derivation projection.
All 148 accepted Groups 1-3 atoms have exact normal, mutation, clickable-cue, and collapsed reading-guide routes.
Exceptional tla fusion is recognized from an intransitive matrix Source beginning with fused tla, not from a matrix-stem list.
The exceptional nominal embed is adverbial and receives a form-or-nature analysis rather than becoming the fused object.
A non-tla-fused or transitive matrix cannot authorize the exceptional form-or-nature analysis.
An ordinary means or instrument analysis remains distinct even when the matrix contains fused tla.
A form-or-nature versus means choice is required only when the typed Source supplies both compatible analyses.
Direct-adverb and transformed-supplement histories remain distinct typed Source routes despite possible surface identity.
A single compatible adverb Source history is selected automatically.
Multiple compatible adverb Source histories require an explicit choice, and a mismatched choice is rejected.
Adverb incorporation preserves matrix valence instead of consuming an object position.
Adverb incorporation preserves the matrix subject and every object carrier.
A means or instrument embed is neither the finite subject nor a passive agent.
Possessor deletion depends on typed referent identity rather than a body-part or clothing nounstem list.
A possessor coreferential with a matrix participant loses its separate representation automatically.
A noncoreferential possessor remains represented.
A referent choice appears only when more than one typed candidate remains genuinely possible.
Changing the nounstem while preserving the same grammatical and referential facts preserves the means or instrument rule.
Place incorporation uses the shared incorporated-adverb owner rather than a place-specific generator.
Simple and compound typed NNC Results are equally eligible to serve as place embeds.
A compound place embed is admitted from its owner-issued Result rather than its witness spelling.
The complete place embed and every internal morphemic boundary remain preserved in the Result.
Place incorporation preserves every matrix participant and leaves matrix valence unchanged.
Place possessor suppression follows the same typed referent-identity rule as means and instrument.
Time, duration, cause, and purpose are grammatical adverb relations handled by the shared owner.
Temporal extent and causal or purposive scope are derived from the typed relation.
Purpose and lack readings remain contextual reading facts and never authorize a productive route.
A relation Analysis appears only when the typed Source retains more than one grammatical relation.
Ordinary form-or-style adverbs remain productive and distinct from the exceptional tla-fusion Source analysis.
Ordinary manner and form-or-style incorporation preserve matrix participants and valence.
An intransitive compared-manner Source automatically compares its subject.
A transitive compared-manner Source requests subject versus object only when both targets remain possible.
A single typed comparison target is applied automatically without a user control.
Cause versus compared manner remains a user Analysis only where both typed Source histories survive.
Changing a compatible nounstem or verbstem shape while holding grammatical facts fixed preserves place, temporal, and manner behavior.
All 234 accepted Groups 7-9 atoms have exact normal, mutation, clickable-cue, and collapsed reading-guide routes.
A unique lexical embed analysis contributes typed evidence but never authorizes the productive incorporation route.
An unlisted compatible nounstem remains productive with or without a unique lexical analysis.
A unique analysis whose recorded stem conflicts with the typed Source is rejected as inconsistent evidence.
Real and supportive initial i remain distinct, and reduplication automatically requires real initial i.
Unique lexical structure and uncertainty survive ordinary continuation without becoming grammar authority.
A supplementary-subject adverb requires an owner-issued possessive NNC and an intransitive principal.
The supplementary possessor changes from possessive to nominative and becomes the finite matrix subject.
The promoted subject retains referent identity and its deeper semantic relation to the incorporated supplement.
Supplementary-subject incorporation preserves matrix valence and keeps supplementation distinct from incorporation.
A supplementary-object adverb requires an owner-issued possessive NNC and a transitive principal.
The supplementary possessor changes from possessive to objective and fills the matrix object role.
Matrix derivational history is typed from the Source or captured Result and never inferred from a stem list.
Intimate possessive supplementation is blocked with an applicative principal by typed derivational history.
A licensed less-intimate imitation remains possible with an applicative principal.
Passive adverbialized-subject passage requires a transitive active Source and a passive target.
Under passive, the active subject is discarded and its supplementary subject survives only as an adverb.
The former active object becomes the passive subject while matrix participant history remains preserved.
No passive agent can be expressed in the passive supplementary-adverb construction.
All 328 accepted Groups 10-12 atoms have exact normal, mutation, clickable-cue, and collapsed reading-guide routes.
An incorporated complement is a necessary internal completion and does not consume a matrix object position.
Subject- and object-oriented complements are selected from typed participant structure rather than matrix-stem identity.
The embedded nominal subject is deleted only when typed referent identity unifies it with the selected matrix participant.
Multiple eligible object referents require a target choice; one eligible referent is applied automatically.
Considering, changing, and pretending remain typed complement analyses rather than English-translation gates.
Complement-boundary w plus m assimilation changes the realization to m-m while preserving the fuller Source analysis.
Reduplication may attach to the embed boundary, matrix boundary, or both without erasing either typed Source.
A reduplication semantic choice appears only when more than one licensed scope survives.
The completed incorporated compound, not an example template, enters the ordinary nonactive owner.

An intransitive completed compound or one with only nonspecific objects licenses impersonal.
A single-object incorporated-object Result is intransitive and therefore blocks passive while permitting impersonal.
An impersonal Result has a faceless third-singular nominative subject distinct from the nominal embed.
The incorporated nominal embed is never the finite subject on any Lesson 30 route.
The incorporated nominal embed is never an agent, including under passive.
No passive-agent mention can be licensed through the incorporated nominal.
Means and instrument readings remain adverbial roles rather than agent or subject reanalyses.
Translation fields cannot override the typed participant structure.
Changing compatible embed Source shape while holding clause facts fixed preserves complement, reduplication, and nonactive behavior.
